theme: A travel day north, with a few professional threads quietly pulling at you
greeting: You're wheels-up to Portland this afternoon, Dan, with the girls settled in Florida — an open stretch of a day. The real tug is professional: a Toronto panel call to lock and two booking windows closing before they feel urgent.

needsAttention.detail: Claudia at ICGN is scheduling the planning call for your Plenary 7 panel — Evolving Stewardship Data, Reporting and Impact — in Toronto and is waiting on your availability.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Pema's Sun Life intro
needsAttention.detail: Pema connected you this morning with Marissa, who leads sustainability work at Sun Life; the intro is open and waiting on your reply.

needsAttention.title: December break — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: The three-week holiday trip for all four girls still needs a destination decided and refundable bookings placed by Oct 15, when holiday inventory for six is thinnest.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: With the Pathfinder heading south, there's no six-seater in Maine for Christmas — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland sells out over the holidays, so hold one now.

acts.line: A quiet start in St. Pete before the airport — bags packed, then out the door.
A midday flight from Tampa to Portland is the one fixed point on an otherwise open day.
Settle into Maine, with an early 7 AM Valoris call with Mike, Martin and Davit waiting tomorrow.
